links.outcome: Patient acceptance of AI-assisted dermatology care by race and skin tone
links.effect: Darker skin tone and Black race predicted lower acceptance of AI-assisted care (P = 0.01 and P = 0.003, respectively).
links.quote: Darker skin tone and Black race predicted lower acceptance of AI-assisted care (P = 0.01 and P = 0.003, respectively), while greater technology familiarity predicted higher acceptance (P = 0.05).

unlisted_practices: Patient preference for clinician-guided AI over standalone AI apps in dermatology
Patient comfort with AI varying by clinical scenario (new, serious, sensitive concerns)

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of patient perceptions, trust, comfort, and equity regarding AI-assisted vs. standalone AI in dermatology.
